EventsEnhanced.PluginDescription: Enhance Matomo native events reports with detailed dimension pages
EventsEnhanced.EventDetailDocumentation: Detailed analytics for a specific event dimension value.
EventsEnhanced.EventActionsForCategoryDocumentation: This report shows all event actions triggered for the selected event category.
EventsEnhanced.EventNamesForCategoryDocumentation: This report shows all event names triggered for the selected event category.
EventsEnhanced.EventCategoriesForActionDocumentation: This report shows all event categories where the selected event action was triggered.
EventsEnhanced.EventNamesForActionDocumentation: This report shows all event names triggered for the selected event action.
EventsEnhanced.EventCategoriesForNameDocumentation: This report shows all event categories where the selected event name was triggered.
EventsEnhanced.EventActionsForNameDocumentation: This report shows all event actions triggered for the selected event name.
EventsEnhanced.EventCategoriesEvolutionDocumentation: This report shows the evolution of top event categories over time, with each category displayed as a separate line.
EventsEnhanced.EventActionsEvolutionDocumentation: This report shows the evolution of top event actions over time, with each action displayed as a separate line.
EventsEnhanced.EventNamesEvolutionDocumentation: This report shows the evolution of top event names over time, with each name displayed as a separate line.
EventsEnhanced.EventsWithAllDimensionsDocumentation: This report shows all events with Category, Action, and Name displayed as separate columns in each row.
EventsEnhanced.EventsDerivedFromActionsDocumentation: The events GA4 collects automatically, rebuilt from Matomo data so you can compare Matomo with the GA4 Events report: session_start, first_visit, page_view, click (outlinks), file_download, view_search_results and, with Media Analytics, video_start, video_progress and video_complete, and with Form Analytics, form_start and form_submit. They are not Matomo events: they complement Events (All Dimensions) without mixing with it and do not appear in the other Events reports. The Counted from column shows the Matomo data behind each row.
EventsEnhanced.DimensionNoData: Dimension %s has no data for the selected period.
EventsEnhanced.DimensionsNoData: Dimensions %s have no data for the selected period.
EventsEnhanced.EventDetailsRowActionDescription: Open detailed analytics page for this event

OpenmostCommunication.Matomo6Body: Upgrading now is simpler than catching up in a few months: new features and security improvements land on Matomo 6 first, and we move you there with your reports and tracking intact.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsTitle: Need help setting up AI chatbot tracking?
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsBody: Openmost can configure AI chatbot tracking for you, on Matomo On-Premise or Cloud.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsCta: Get it set up for me
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanTitle: Events need to be set up manually
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanBody: Events measure clicks, downloads, form submissions or video plays, once they are tracked. As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost designs and implements a tracking plan that fits your site.
OpenmostCommunication.EventsEnhancedLink: Get more out of your events with Events Enhanced
OpenmostCommunication.EcommerceEnhancedBody: Ecommerce Enhanced greatly extends Matomo's ecommerce features with new reports on products, brands, promotions, coupons, checkout funnels and buyers. It fits easily into your online store, with no specific development. Free plugin by Openmost.
